content: We conduct a human evaluation with 12 participants, 8 male and 4 female, who are affiliated project researchers aged 20-39 at the University of [ANON]. We choose the same five evaluation characters as in Section SECREF28. To control bias, each participant evaluates one or two characters. For each character, we randomly select 10 testing samples (each includes an initial line of dialogue along with 20 candidate responses, one of which is the ground truth) from the same testing data for the automatic evaluation discussed in Section SECREF28.
